summary: Iteration 11 — full test of Task 3 МОДИФИКАТОРЫ and Task 4 КЛИЕНТЫ И СКИДКИ. New suite /app/backend/tests/test_modifiers_clients_iter11.py (23 tests, ALL PASS): modifier-group list returns options[] (no _id, group_id matches), seeded 'Добавки' (multiple 0-3, Доп. сыр +1.5 with Сыр 0.02, Бекон +2.0, Без лука 0), full group/option CRUD with GET-verified persistence, option on unknown group -> 404, group delete cascades options AND $pulls the id from products.modifier_group_ids, every modifier mutation manager-only (PIN admin 2222 and waiter 1111 -> 403 on all 6 endpoints, read allowed), PUT /products persists modifier_group_ids, order pricing (burger 12.5 + Доп.сыр 1.5 = item total 14.0 / subtotal 14.0; count 2 -> 28.0; client-supplied 'total' field ignored), kitchen ticket via /orders/{id}/send contains '  + Доп. сыр' indented under the dish and the precheck too, pay write-off of the modifier ingredient (writeoff kind=sale, name 'Сыр (модификатор)', amount 0.02, warehouse_id set, per-warehouse stock decremented), client CRUD (create/dup 400/format-insensitive lookup/404/update+dup-guard/delete manager-only, waiter can read+create), pay with client discount (total 12.6, discount 1.4, discount_percent 10.0, discount_source 'client:Иван Петров', client_name stored; manual -> 'manual'; order.client_id used when pay omits it), /reports/sales?group_by=client rows+totals consistent and manager-only, standard /reports/sales unchanged, unauthenticated -> 403. Full regression 196 passed (1 pre-existing xdist race, see flaky note). Frontend verified end-to-end: /admin/menu 'Модификаторы' tab (create/edit/delete group, create option, delete cascade), product-modal modifier chips toggle, /admin/clients list+search+add+edit+delete, /admin/reports 'По клиентам' (Иван Петров, 5 заказов, скидка 3.90 ₽, выручка 60.10 ₽), POS: picker opens only for products with modifiers, mandatory group blocks confirm with toast 'Выберите минимум 1 в «...»', cart shows indented modifier + line price 12.00 (10.00 + 2.00), checkout client lookup shows 'Иван Петров скидка 10%', pre-fills 3.00 and 'Источник: Клиент (10%)', payment produced a receipt with 'Клиент Иван Петров / Скидка (10%) -3.00 / ИТОГО 27.00' and the backend order stored discount_source='client:Иван Петров'. Zero console/page errors. 7 hardening probes in /app/backend/tests/test_modifiers_edge_iter11.py fail and pin real defects (modifier price trust, min/max not enforced, unrelated modifiers accepted, substring phone lookup, missing 404s, unvalidated selection_type).

critical.issue: calc_items() trusts the client-supplied selected_modifiers[].price_delta (and .name) — it is never resolved from db.modifier_options. Proven: burger with option 'Доп. сыр' sent as price_delta=-100 -> order subtotal -87.5 accepted and payable. The claim 'modifier line pricing is authoritative on backend' is false. Fix: load each option by option_id+restaurant_id and recompute delta/name server-side (ignore payload values).

Modifier group rules are enforced only in the POS UI: (a) max_count ignored — 4 copies of the same option for a group with max_count=3 accepted (subtotal 18.5); (b) min_count never checked on the API; (c) an option from a group NOT attached to the product is accepted (modifier of 'Добавки' added to a drink). A waiter hitting the API directly (or a stale client) can build invalid/mispriced orders. Fix: validate selected_modifiers against the product's modifier_group_ids and each group's min/max in calc paths -> 400.

minor.issue: Lookup uses an unanchored {'$regex': digits} so any substring matches: ?phone=123 returned 'Иван Петров'. A short/partial number typed at POS checkout can silently attribute the sale and discount to the wrong client. Use an exact phone_digits match (or a suffix-anchored match) and 404 otherwise.

Uniqueness compares raw digits without canonicalisation, so the SAME phone in another national format creates a second client. Reproduced through the UI: '+7 999 111-22-33' (79991112233) then '9991112233' -> both created ('Сохранено'), no 400. '8 999 111-22-33' would be a third. Normalise to a canonical form (strip leading 7/8 or store the last 10 digits) before the dup check and add a unique index on {restaurant_id, phone_digits}.
Unknown/foreign id returns HTTP 200 with a null body instead of 404 (update_one matches nothing). Frontend can't distinguish success from a no-op.
Deleting a non-existent client returns 200 {'success': true} (deleted_count not checked) — should be 404, like DELETE /orders.
selection_type has no field_validator — 'bogus' is stored (min_count/max_count are also unbounded: negative/max<min accepted), which the POS picker then interprets arbitrarily.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Мин.'/'Макс.' inputs are rendered only when selection_type === 'multiple', so a mandatory single-choice group (single + min_count=1, the classic 'choose a sauce' case) cannot be configured from the UI at all — min stays 0/max 1.
Escape still does not close modals (modifier group/option, client) — only the X button. Pre-existing (iteration 10).

issues: The 'Добавить в заказ' button stays enabled when a mandatory group is unsatisfied and only fires an error toast on click — the spec said it should block; works, but disabling the button (or showing the requirement inline) is clearer
Тип выбора / Ингредиент selects are native browser <select> elements (OS-styled dropdown) inside the dark themed UI — inconsistent with the rest of the design system

action_items: CRITICAL: recompute modifier price_delta/name from db.modifier_options in calc_items (never trust the payload) — a forged delta currently yields a negative subtotal that can be paid
Validate selected_modifiers server-side: option must belong to a group listed in the product's modifier_group_ids, and per-group counts must respect min_count/max_count -> 400
Make GET /api/clients?phone an exact (or suffix-anchored) phone_digits match instead of an unanchored regex
Canonicalise phone digits before the duplicate check (+7/8/10-digit forms must collide) and add a unique index on {restaurant_id, phone_digits}
Return 404 from PUT /modifier-groups/{gid}, PUT .../options/{oid} and DELETE /clients/{cid} when nothing matched
Add a field_validator for selection_type and sane bounds for min_count/max_count
UI: show Мин./Макс. for single-choice groups too (or expose a 'обязательная группа' switch) so mandatory single groups are configurable
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2475 lines — modifier, client, order, warehouse and report handlers all live in one file; split into routers before Task 5 (raised in iteration 10, still open)

calc_items() is a pure function over client input; move it to an async helper that resolves product price AND modifier deltas from the DB — today both item['price'] and price_delta are client-controlled, so the order total is fully client-defined

pay_order() duplicates the write-off block for recipe ingredients and for modifier options (~20 near-identical lines); extract writeoff_ingredient(rid, inventory_id, name, amount, wh_id, kind, reason)

The modifier write-off ignores unit conversion metadata (convert_amount(opt['amount'], None, stock_unit)) — the option amount is assumed to already be in the stock unit; document this in the UI label or add a unit field to ModifierOptionReq
GET /api/modifier-groups loads up to 5000 options and groups them in Python on every call — fine for demo scale, but the options query should at least be indexed on {restaurant_id, group_id}

success_rate.backend: 100% (23/23 Task-3/Task-4 feature tests pass; 196 passed in full regression); 0/7 hardening probes pass — all 7 document real defects
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows pass (menu modifiers CRUD, product chips, clients CRUD+search, reports По клиентам, POS picker/mandatory block/cart mods/client lookup/discount/pay+receipt)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Task-3/4 regression: /app/backend/tests/test_modifiers_clients_iter11.py (self-contained, creates+deletes its own TEST_ groups/options/products/clients; requires an open shift and opens one if missing). /app/backend/tests/test_modifiers_edge_iter11.py intentionally FAILS 7 probes pinning open defects (modifier price_delta trust, max_count, unrelated modifier, substring phone lookup, missing 404s on PUT group/option and DELETE client, unvalidated selection_type) — they should turn green after the fixes. Not re-tested this round: multi-tenancy (iter9), warehouse/Task-2 (iter10) — note iteration-10 defects (warehouse delete balance desync, unvalidated warehouse_id) were NOT re-checked and may still be open.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the pricing defect: calc_items(items) (server.py ~909) computes mods = sum(m.get('price_delta', 0) for m in it['selected_modifiers']) directly from the request body; SelectedModifier is a plain Pydantic model with a free-form price_delta, and no handler ever loads db.modifier_options during order create/update — options are only read at pay time for stock write-off. Repro: POST /api/orders with selected_modifiers=[{group_id, option_id (real), name, price_delta: -100}] -> 200 with subtotal -87.5. Same class of issue for group min/max and product-group membership (validated only in Pos.jsx toggleModOption/confirmModifiers). Mitigation: fetch the referenced options once per order write, reject unknown/unattached options, override delta+name from the DB, and count selections per group against min_count/max_count. Client defect RCA: phone_digits is the raw digit string, so canonical-form differences ('79991112233' vs '9991112233') bypass the uniqueness check, while the lookup compensates with an unanchored $regex — the two bugs combine into 'duplicates allowed, wrong client matched'.
